intro.text: A region of Roshar that was part of Makabakam in the time of the Silver Kingdoms.
A small nation in southern Roshar on the Tarat Sea, bordering Greater Hexi, Triax, Emul and Tu Bayla.

description.text: A stream running through the caverns under Urithiru can be followed for several days' march until it reaches an outlet in Tu Fallia's mountain foothills.
Szeth thinks of it as a nomadic backwater like Hexi. It is a nation in name only, with no organised government at all, looser even than the tribal coalition of Marat.

In a vision, Dalinar sees its lush valleys, dense with plants bearing broad green leaves and tightly tangled vines. Leathery-skinned animals with long tentacles squeeze into gaps beneath the undergrowth to hide from highstorms.
